name: Responsible
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of responsibility both in personal conduct and in the stewardship of others, especially children. Proverbs 22:6 instructs parents to diligently train their children in the right way, promising lasting impact. Philippians 2:3 calls believers to humility and selflessness, highlighting responsible attitudes toward others. James 4:17 warns that knowing the good to do yet failing to act is sinful, underscoring that responsibility involves active obedience.
